title: Septennial
summary: SEPTEN'NIAL, adjective [L. septennis; septem, seven, and annus, year.] 1. Lasting or continuing seven years; as septennial parliaments. 2. Happening or returning once in wvery seven years; as septenni

inlines.v: SEPTEN'NIAL, adjective [L. septennis; septem, seven, and annus, year.] 1. Lasting or continuing seven years; as septennial parliaments. 2. Happening or returning once in wvery seven years; as septennial elections in England.
